Review this claim and the attached argument: “Every linear map between real normed spaces is continuous.” Determine its validity with a rigorous justification. If hypotheses are missing, identify a correct version and examine which step of the argument needs repair. Write a self-contained result.

files.argument.txt: Let T:E→F be linear. For h≠0, T(h)=||h|| T(h/||h||). Since h/||h|| has norm one, ||T(h/||h||)||≤C for some constant C. Therefore ||T(h)||≤C||h|| and T is continuous.
